changelog:
- Initial release of agent-prompt-builder skill.
- Automatically generates structured system prompts for AI agents based on defined beliefs and responsibilities.
- Integrates with the Live Neon Agent platform for seamless identity and prompt management.
- Supports dynamic prompt generation, hierarchical inheritance, and compatibility with any LLM.
- Includes command-line tools for registration, discovery, review, build, syncing content, and organizational management.
summary: Stop writing system prompts by hand — let structured identity generate them automatically from beliefs and responsibilities
